decisions.decision: Notification payload grammar is fixed at {kind}:{id} — literally due:{vehicleId} and odo:{vehicleId}. due: routes to /, odo: routes to /?sheet=odo. /vehicle/:id is never added to the route table.
decisions.rationale: One-way door: a payload is serialised into the OS scheduled-notification store and handed back to whatever build is installed when it fires, up to 120 days later. Confirmed by the user at 04-01 Task 1's blocking checkpoint; matches P4-D-01/P4-D-02 and the source doc's SS10.7 verbatim. The versioned and json alternatives were presented and declined. Now shipped in code and covered by tests in test/domain/notification_plan_test.dart.

decisions.decision: Executor dispatch prompts reference the large GSD docs by absolute path as Read-tool instructions instead of inlining ~103 KB verbatim per dispatch.
decisions.rationale: execute-phase.md asks the orchestrator to inline the reference material into every executor prompt. @-includes genuinely do not expand inside an Agent() prompt (#3324), but an explicit Read-tool instruction does, at ~26K fewer output tokens per dispatch. gsd-executor.md already @-references checkpoints.md and summary.md itself.
